prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Generate ONE English Patterns learning atlas.
Pattern context: I can + base verb. Style: Photorealistic everyday editorial photography, warm natural light, coherent with the existing learning atlases.
Canvas width:height MUST be THREE:FOUR (0.75), not 1:2. Exactly 3 columns by 4 rows of SQUARE photographic cells, with narrow continuous pure white divider gutters. All twelve cells visible. Final display contract 1536x2048.
Conservative Arab Muslim family learning contexts. Men wear loose opaque long-sleeved high-neck shirts and full-length trousers or thobes. Women wear loose opaque full-coverage clothing and hijab. Apply modest clothing to background people too.
No bare torso, shoulders, midriff or thighs, tight or transparent clothes, revealing nightwear, swimwear, underwear, changing, bathing, showering, intimate or romantic poses, kissing or inappropriate physical contact.
Water and beach contexts use fully clothed people on a dry shore, promenade or empty poolside. Never show swimmers, sunbathers, mixed bathing or distant revealing figures. Depict swimming discussions before the activity, with equipment where useful.
No alcohol, gambling, nightclub setting, graphic injury, active weapon violence, or religious caricatures. Use ordinary respectful Arab settings without adding religious rituals unrelated to the sentence.
Preserve the exact English sentence and Arabic meaning. Adapt only the visual staging. If a compliant scene cannot convey the meaning honestly, hold the cell for review instead of substituting an unrelated picture.
No captions, words, numbers, logos, speech/thought bubbles, graphic overlays or floating inset pictures. Physical analog clocks can use hands and tick marks for time examples.
Exactly three columns and four rows in row-major order, twelve square cells, portrait 3:4, final atlas 1536x2048, 512x512 per cell with 40px safe inset and continuous straight white dividers. Measure actual source gutters before preparing the display atlas.
The following English sentences are context only: do not render their text. Exact panel order, left to right then top to bottom:
1. Meaning: I can speak English. Visual staging: An adult confidently speaking with an English-language learner.
2. Meaning: I can help you today. Visual staging: An adult offering to help a colleague today.
3. Meaning: I can ride a bike. Visual staging: An adult riding a bicycle on a quiet cycle path.
4. Meaning: I can answer this question. Visual staging: An adult learner raising a hand to answer a question.
5. Meaning: I can cook dinner while you finish your work. Visual staging: An adult preparing dinner while a partner works at a nearby desk.
6. Meaning: I can explain the route without a map. Visual staging: An adult explaining a route to a traveler using hand gestures.
7. Meaning: I can carry the smaller suitcase. Visual staging: An adult lifting the smaller of two suitcases.
8. Meaning: I can read the instructions on this screen. Visual staging: An adult reading a screen and showing the instructions to a friend.
9. Meaning: I can meet you after my lesson. Visual staging: An adult arranging a meeting while leaving a classroom.
10. Meaning: I can fix a flat bicycle tire. Visual staging: An adult repairing a bicycle tire with a small tool kit.
11. Meaning: I can work with people from different backgrounds. Visual staging: A diverse group of adults cooperating around a work table.
12. Meaning: I can understand the main idea, even if I miss a few words. Visual staging: An adult learner listening carefully and taking brief notes.

Use the supplied atlas only for its3:4 outer shape, exact equal-square3columns4rows and warm photo style. Replace all existing photographs with the12 new ability scenes. No breakfast content. All figures are fully modestly clothed, including the cyclist with loose full-length trousers and opaque long sleeves, and every background colleague. Use same-gender adults for route explanation, practical help and meetings. Cell5 a fully clothed man cooking at a kitchen counter while his spouse in opaque hijab and loose full coverage works at a separate nearby desk, no intimacy. Cell8 a real screen with no readable words, the adult points naturally to it. Cell10 practical bicycle tyre repair, not merely holding a bicycle. No text or graphics anywhere. Twelve strictly equal square cells, straight narrow white full-length gutters.
